ArtifactDetail.description:
One artifact plus the canonical time bounds of its samples.

The bounds require reading the Parquet footer/column statistics, so they are
served only for a single requested artifact and never inside a list
response. A laboratory uses them to choose a deterministic first window
instead of asking the reader to guess a time range.
ArtifactDetail.title: ArtifactDetail

EntityObservationView.description: Stable observed-frame bounds for one entity in a dense artifact.
EntityObservationView.title: EntityObservationView

GameEditionView.description: A competition edition that owns discrete game-grain data.
GameEditionView.title: GameEditionView

LicenseView.description: Declared license/rights policy as stored by the rights authority.
LicenseView.title: LicenseView

MetricCatalogEntry.description:
One registered metric plus where it is actually served.

`dataset_ids` and `value_count` come from the derived rows, so the catalog
can distinguish a metric the registry defines from one the pipeline has
genuinely computed; discovery should not offer the former as if it were
analysable.
MetricCatalogEntry.title: MetricCatalogEntry

MetricValue.description: One derived metric value with its full provenance envelope.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

ReductionInfo.description: Explicit display-reduction record; never a scientific transformation.
ReductionInfo.title: ReductionInfo

SeasonEditionView.description: A competition edition that owns season-grain data, with its provenance.
SeasonEditionView.title: SeasonEditionView

SeasonFamilyRef.description: One provider aggregate family materialized for a competition edition.
SeasonFamilyRef.title: SeasonFamilyRef

SeasonFamilyView.description: Family metadata: metric registry and population facets. No metric values.
SeasonFamilyView.title: SeasonFamilyView

SeasonPlayerLinksView.description: Contests linked to a season subject through the provider identity crosswalk.
SeasonPlayerLinksView.title: SeasonPlayerLinksView

SeasonPopulationView.description: The explicit denominator every rank/percentile is relative to.
SeasonPopulationView.title: SeasonPopulationView

SeasonProfileView.description: Reproducible season profile: context, values, denominator and provenance.
SeasonProfileView.title: SeasonProfileView

SeasonRowView.description: One grain row: subject × team × edition × position group.
SeasonRowView.title: SeasonRowView

SportsCatalogMatchView.description: Metadata-only contest entry from the normalized sports and source catalogs.
SportsCatalogMatchView.title: SportsCatalogMatchView

info.description: Precomputed, provenance-explicit serving of the DynamisData gold/metadata plane. Dense windows are bounded and display-reduced; scientific values are never recomputed here.
info.title: DynamisData Analytical API
